# Teodora Vlasic

Novelist, member of the monthly writing group, and my first reader for whole drafts. Two novels of her own; she is writing a third, about a dye works.

## How we work together

- She reads whole parts, not chapters, and writes back within three weeks with a two-page letter and pencil marks on the paper copy. I read hers on the same terms.
- She is the reader who tells me where she got lost. Her notes are almost entirely about attention: where she skimmed, where she checked back, where she stopped caring.
- We trade reads; no money changes hands. I owe her a read of her part two in the new year.

## Current threads

- Read part one of the third draft and reported at the group on 2026-09-09 ([[teodora-reads-part-one-2026-09-09]], [[teodora-reader-notes-part-one-2026-09-09]]): chronology works, Constance's letters are the best thing in it, the prologue made her read part one "waiting for the boat".
- Part two goes to her when finished (target 2026-11-27). Her read of it is what I want before settling [[should-the-salt-choir-keep-the-storm-prologue]].

## History

- Her notes on draft one ([[teodora-reader-notes-draft-one-2026-01-20]]) said Nell felt "lonely in a crowded town", which I now read as the same diagnosis as Imogen's.
